components-bottom-sheet.name: BottomSheet
components-bottom-sheet.description:
A message or a decision that keeps the user on the current screen:
a limit reached, an error with one next step, a reminder that can wait

reactDocgen.description:
A message or a decision that keeps the user on the current screen:
a limit reached, an error with one next step, a reminder that can wait

type.description: Message – with an illustration, centred; Functional – text and actions only

closable.description: Shows the close button. Turn off when the user must choose an action

closeLabel.description: Accessible name of the close button – translate with the rest of the copy

stories.name: Message
stories.snippet:
const Message = () => <BottomSheet
    type="message"
    title="Today’s limit reached"
    subtitle="Verify your identity to send more today. It takes about 3 minutes"
    illustration="cat"
    closable
    actions={{ primary: 'Verify now' }}
    {...(globals.locale === 'ru' ? { closeLabel: 'Закрыть', ...parameters.ru } : {})} />;

stories.name: Two Actions
stories.snippet:
const TwoActions = () => <BottomSheet
    type="message"
    title="Today’s limit reached"
    subtitle="Verify your identity to send more today. It takes about 3 minutes"
    illustration="cat"
    closable
    actions={{ primary: 'Verify now', secondary: 'Change amount' }}
    {...(globals.locale === 'ru' ? { closeLabel: 'Закрыть', ...parameters.ru } : {})} />;

stories.name: Not Closable
Functional
stories.snippet:
const Functional = () => <BottomSheet

    actions={{ primary: 'Open email', secondary: 'Not now' }}

stories.name: Loading
stories.snippet:
const Loading = () => <BottomSheet

components-button.name: Button

variant.description: Primary – the one main action of a screen; Secondary – an alternative next to it; Ghost – low emphasis

loading.description: Spinner replaces the label, the width stays the same

fullWidth.description: Stretch to the container width (Primary and Secondary in sheets and full screens)

pressed.description: Shows the pressed look without pressing – for documentation

components-full-screen-message.name: FullscreenMessage
components-full-screen-message.description:
A result or a requirement the user must see before going on:
success, a blocking check, an empty state with an action

reactDocgen.description:
A result or a requirement the user must see before going on:
success, a blocking check, an empty state with an action

illustration.description: Pass null to hide the illustration

header.description: Shows the top bar with a back button

backLabel.description: Accessible name of the back button

stories.name: Success
stories.snippet:
const Success = () => <FullscreenMessage
    title="Money is on its way"
    subtitle="We’ll let you know when it arrives. Usually it takes a few minutes"
    illustration="money"
    header
    actions={{ primary: 'Done', secondary: 'Share receipt' }}
    {...(globals.locale === 'ru' ? { backLabel: 'Назад', ...parameters.ru } : {})} />;

components-list-item.name: ListItem
components-list-item.description: A row for settings, profile, accounts and countries

reactDocgen.description: A row for settings, profile, accounts and countries

lead.description: Leading element: a country flag, an icon, or nothing

follower.description: Chevron that shows the row opens something. Makes the row a button

alignment.description: Top when the left text wraps to two lines
